issue_context.title: AIP-84 Migrate the public endpoint Get DAG Source to FastAPI
issue_context.body:
### Description

Currently the Get DAG Source public endpoint is at `api_connexion/endpoints/dag_source_endpoint.py` under `get_dag_source`. We need to migrate it to the `api_fastapi/views/public/dag_sources.py` under a `get_dag_source` or similar.

Features and functionality of the endpoint will remain unchanged.

### Use case/motivation

AIP-84 cWiki Link: https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/AIRFLOW/AIP-84+UI+REST+API

### Related issues

Related to: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/42370

### Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [X] Yes I am willing to submit a PR!

### Code of Conduct

- [X] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

review_comments:
Remove `422`, it is automatically handled by FastAPI and documented.

Added `406` to the documentatation.
Handle the `any` mime_type as well, in case any is specified, or no `accept` header is specified.
Looks like you've added this already, thanks!

Rename Dag Serializer. `Model` is already used for ORM/SQLAlchemy entities. We should try to avoid to name things models for serializers. We can use `serializers` or just `Response/Body` as most of the time the serializers are specific to a response or body context.
Yes `Response` sounds good, thanks for updating this.
